intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene (301057) on chromosome Xp21.1.

checks.claim: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is caused by hemizygous mutation in the CFAP47 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: Paper shows hemizygous CFAP47 mutations cause X-linked MMAF/asthenoteratozoospermia; SPGFX3 is OMIM nomenclature.

checks.claim: The CFAP47 gene is located on chromosome Xp21.1.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: The Xp21.1 deletion removes CFAP47, so the gene is at Xp21.1.

paragraphs.text: X-linked spermatogenic failure-3 (SPGFX3) is a form of primary male infertility characterized by asthenoteratozoospermia with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF) (Liu et al., 2021).

checks.claim: SPGFX3 is a form of primary male infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: Deleterious variants in X-linked CFAP47 induce asthenoteratozoospermia and primary male infertility.
checks.explanation: The title describes the condition as primary male infertility.

checks.claim: SPGFX3 is characterized by asthenoteratozoospermia with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF).
checks.evidence_quote: Asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by multiple morphological abnormalities of the flagella (MMAF) has been identified as a sub-type of male infertility.
checks.explanation: The abstract describes the phenotype as asthenoteratozoospermia with MMAF.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) reported 3 unrelated Chinese men with primary infertility and asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by MMAF. An Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia, identified in a second cohort, also showed typical MMAF phenotypes.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) reported 3 unrelated Chinese men with primary infertility.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The abstract confirms 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF. Primary infertility is mentioned only in the title, not specifically for these men.

checks.claim: The 3 unrelated Chinese men reported by Liu et al. (2021) had asthenoteratozoospermia characterized by MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The 3 Chinese men had MMAF, which the abstract defines as a form of asthenoteratozoospermia.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) identified an Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia in a second cohort.
checks.evidence_quote: WES data from an additional cohort of severe asthenoteratozoospermic men originating from Australia permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion
checks.explanation: A carrier of the deletion was identified in the Australian cohort; the abstract mentions a single deletion, read here as one man.

checks.claim: The Australian man with severe asthenoteratozoospermia reported by Liu et al. (2021) showed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.evidence_quote: All men harboring hemizygous CFAP47 variants displayed typical MMAF phenotypes.
checks.explanation: This statement covers all carriers, including the man with the deletion.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) reported a man with MMAF, identified among 7 men with MMAF who were screened for gene mutations.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF for gene mutations.
checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals
checks.explanation: Seven individuals with MMAF were screened.

checks.claim: Liao et al. (2022) reported a man with MMAF identified among the 7 screened men with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals and found two novel mutations in CFAP47 (c.706G>A, Val236Met; c.1337C>T, Thr446Met) in one case.
checks.explanation: One of the seven, later called the 'CFAP47-mutated man', was reported.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) found hemizygous variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene in affected men. They concluded that SPGFX3 follows X-linked inheritance.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) found hemizygous variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene in men affected with SPGFX3.
checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The abstract reports hemizygous variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene in affected men.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) concluded that SPGFX3 follows X-linked inheritance.
checks.evidence_quote: hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia
checks.explanation: The authors conclude the condition is X-linked.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) performed whole-exome sequencing in 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF and identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 gene. None of the 3 variants was found in human control population genome databases, and multiple bioinformatic tools predicted them to be deleterious. Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays showed clearly reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all 3 men. In whole-exome sequencing data from an additional cohort of Australian men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia, Liu et al. (2021) identified a hemizygous deletion at Xp21.1 that removed the entire CFAP47 gene.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) performed whole-exome sequencing in 3 unrelated Chinese men with MMAF.
checks.evidence_quote: we conducted whole-exome sequencing (WES) and identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF
checks.explanation: The abstract states WES was performed in the 3 men.

checks.evidence_quote: identified hemizygous missense variants in the X-linked CFAP47 in three unrelated Chinese individuals with MMAF

checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly.

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays showed clearly reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all 3 Chinese men with CFAP47 missense variants reported by Liu et al. (2021).
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence assays revealed obviously reduced levels of CFAP47 in spermatozoa from all three men harboring deleterious missense variants of CFAP47.
checks.explanation: "Clearly reduced" is equivalent to the paper's "obviously reduced".

checks.evidence_quote: WES data from an additional cohort of severe asthenoteratozoospermic men originating from Australia
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly.

checks.claim: Liu et al. (2021) identified a hemizygous deletion at Xp21.1 that removed the entire CFAP47 gene in the Australian cohort of men with severe asthenoteratozoospermia.
checks.evidence_quote: permitted the identification of a hemizygous Xp21.1 deletion removing the entire CFAP47 gene
checks.explanation: The abstract states this directly.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with MMAF for gene mutations. In 1 man they identified 2 novel mutations in the CFAP47 gene: c.706G-A (V236M) and c.1337C-T (T446M). Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in the man's spermatozoa. Expression of WDR87, which interacts with CFAP47, was also significantly decreased, and only weak signals were detected adjacent to the sperm nuclei.

checks.evidence_quote: we screened gene mutations in seven MMAF individuals
checks.explanation: Matches the abstract.

checks.evidence_quote: found two novel mutations in CFAP47 (c.706G>A, Val236Met; c.1337C>T, Thr446Met) in one case
checks.explanation: Same variants in one case; the notations are equivalent.

checks.claim: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence showed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in spermatozoa of the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations reported by Liao et al. (2022).
checks.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting and immunofluorescence revealed that CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in spermatozoa from the CFAP47-mutated man.
checks.explanation: Stated directly.

checks.evidence_quote: we identified a cilia- and flagella-associated protein, CFAP47, which interacted with WDR87 in the flagellar midpiece of the spermatozoa
checks.explanation: Stated directly.

checks.claim: Expression of WDR87 was significantly decreased in spermatozoa of the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations reported by Liao et al. (2022).
checks.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the expression of WDR87 was also significantly decreased, and weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei

checks.claim: Only weak WDR87 signals adjacent to the sperm nuclei were detected in spermatozoa of the man with CFAP47 V236M and T446M mutations reported by Liao et al. (2022).
checks.evidence_quote: the expression of WDR87 was also significantly decreased, and weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei
checks.explanation: The paper reports weak signals next to the nuclei. 'Only' is a fair reading of this.

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) found that WDR87 was highly expressed in human and mouse testis and localized to the middle piece of the sperm tail, where it interacted with CFAP47. In spermatozoa from a man with CFAP47 mutations, WDR87 was decreased and was detected only weakly adjacent to the sperm nuclei. Liao et al. (2022) concluded that CFAP47 is necessary for the transport of WDR87 during sperm flagellum biogenesis, and that the 2 proteins form a complex involved in sperm tail assembly.

checks.evidence_quote: the expression of WDR87 was also significantly decreased, and weak signals were detected adjacent to the spermatozoa nuclei

paragraphs.text: On the basis of their findings in humans and mice, Liu et al. (2021) suggested that men with SPGFX3 have a good prognosis with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI).

checks.claim: On the basis of findings in humans and mice, Liu et al. (2021) suggested that men with SPGFX3 have a good prognosis with intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI).
checks.evidence_quote: our experimental observations in humans and mice demonstrate that hemizygous mutations in CFAP47 can induce X-linked MMAF and asthenoteratozoospermia, for which good ICSI prognosis is suggested
checks.explanation: The abstract suggests a good ICSI prognosis based on findings in humans and mice.

paragraphs.text: Liu et al. (2021) generated a Cfap47-mutated mouse model. Adult male mice were sterile and showed reduced sperm motility and abnormal flagellar morphology and movement. Their fertility could be rescued by ICSI.

clinical_synopsis.feature: Multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF)

paragraphs.text: Liao et al. (2022) screened 7 men with multiple morphological abnormalities of the sperm flagella (MMAF). In 1 man they identified a c.706G-A transition in the CFAP47 gene, resulting in a val236-to-met (V236M) substitution, together with a second mutation, T446M. CFAP47 was dramatically reduced in the man's spermatozoa.
